title: vtc: recording consent depends on WebSocket
description: The mandatory consent signal (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:1076,:1519,:1629) is only a WebSocket event: push-only clients and mid-recording joiners never get it, and vtc-wss eventTypes can filter it out. Fix: event not filterable; joining clients check VTCRecording state.
close_reason: VTCRecordingStateEvent delivered regardless of eventTypes; clients SHOULD check VTCRecording/query on join.
